confidence_notes: Food and drink prices come from a web search of 2026 aggregated cost-of-living data for Atlanta, GA. Expatica's page uses Numbeo data dated June 2026. It gives about $25 for an inexpensive meal, $4.92 for a cappuccino and $6 for a domestic draft beer. Expatarrivals (March 2026) gives about $100 for a three-course mid-range meal for two; this is adjusted slightly upward for July 2026 and tax/tip norms. Cocktail and wine prices were not searched directly. They are estimated from typical US big-city price relationships to beer, so they are less certain. All accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against any listings. Atlanta has few hostels, so the dorm and private hostel figures are the least certain. Summer prices can also change around major events.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices are based on Atlanta-specific aggregated cost-of-living data. Accommodation is benchmarked against similar Sun Belt US metros such as Charlotte, Dallas and Nashville.
